derived_from: shipped DEFAULT hourly output (predict_hourly, model path, demand OFF) on the Phase 2 holdout 2026-08-01 -> 2026-10-29 (26,752 camera-days x 24 h = 642,048 camera-hours); the 4 coordinate-less cameras use the shipped profile path (profile + weather + slowness) exactly as predict_hourly does
method: same rule as risk.py (LOW/MEDIUM = round(p50), MEDIUM/HIGH = round(p90)), rounded to 0.1 violations/hour because hourly counts are ~24x smaller than daily counts; score scale = p99 rounded up to nearest 0.5
score: hourly risk_score = clip(predicted / 2.0, 0, 1) (NOT wired into hourly_risk.py yet — see findings doc)
